title: hotfix(home): adds spring back for stars + removes useless renderings

comments.body: @vvo how can I do an hot fix?

Yep so we merge into master, then you run:

``` sh
VERSION=1.0.0 npm run gh-pages
```
Even after publishing gh-pages, it can take 10 minutes for the cloudflare cache to be purged

ah yes and then you can merge back master into develop.

also the commit message would have been "docs(stars): ..". Everything that is docs must be tagged "docs()". Even if hotfix, fix in docs etc..

You can still say "hotfix" in the body that's a good one
